title: Normalized sound definition (legacy sounds domain)
description: Contract for one normalized sound: one stored legacy sounds entry. String-encoded id and numeric params coerce to integers (rule T1); file and description are verbatim asset strings recorded, never validated (rule T3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored sounds string id, preserved verbatim (rule T4).

kind.description: Classification of the stored sounds domain: every sounds entry maps to sound.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets sounds).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets sounds).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Stored string id coerced to an integer (rule T1).

file.description: Sound file asset name, recorded verbatim and never validated; asset truth belongs to M4 (rule T3).

loops.description: Stored string-encoded loop count coerced to an integer (rule T1).

max.description: Stored string-encoded concurrent-play limit coerced to an integer (rule T1).

preload.description: Stored string-encoded preload flag coerced to an integer (rule T1).
